versions.content: Accepted range of Dcm_NegativeResponseCodeType for negative responses If the Dcm calls an external application by any of the API s hav- ing the out parameter Dcm_NegativeResponseCodeType ErrorCode, the Dcm shall accept only values in the range 0x01-0xFF in case the return value is E_NOT_OK.
